title: Name only the working exit when an incremental import refuses a task that links to another project's absent task
outcome: Name only the working exit when an incremental import refuses a task that links to another project's absent task
acceptance: When the incoming folder holds a task whose parent, prerequisite or replacement names another project's task and that task's file is absent from the folder, the incremental task_sync_id_collision refusal names only the exit that works there (remove the linking tasks from the folder and commit), or states that the --rebuild exit applies only while the named task is still in the folder; a test covers that link-only state and shows the named exit succeeds
The task_sync_id_collision row of the refusal-codes table in docs/features/task-planning-text.md also covers a task whose parent, prerequisite or replacement names a task another project holds
